Xiao Hong says, "Yes, I am on the 3 am train, I think about resting here until 12 o'clock, then go out and stay for more than 2 hours." At this time, the conductor suddenly reminds, "Pay attention to the broadcast to remind you to get on the train, do not miss the train."

[Question]
What is the real meaning when the conductor says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. The conductor reminds Xiao Hong to pay attention to the train schedule to prevent missing the train.
B. The conductor implies that Xiao Hong can rest in the waiting room until she boards the train.
